SMDATE4 000: Johnny alone in formal outfit, leaning and moving screen-left with back leg lifted behind to screen-right; head and body face left, eyes look up-left. Both forearms reach forward low toward the left, with near forearm crossing his belly and visible white cuffs. Preserve the exact separated stance and flowing coat tails; no table or chair yet.

SMDATE4 001: Johnny partly faces viewer in a wide crouching step, forward bare foot on image-left and bent rear leg/foot on image-right. He carries a red wooden chair diagonally at screen-right, its oval cutout back upper-right and legs projecting down-left; his nearer hand grips the chair underside, shoulder-elbow-wrist continuous. The far arm reaches to support the partial white tablecloth/table visible along the left edge. Preserve the partial red chair-back at far upper-left and yellow item on the white table. Costume as source; focused face looking left.

SMDATE4 002: Johnny braces legs in a wide low stance, one knee lifted and bare foot pointing down-left while other foot is planted far right. He faces left three-quarter, looking up at the load. His far hand at left holds aloft a little table with white draped cloth, red legs, yellow food on a dish and a partial red oval-backed chair behind it. The near arm extends straight to right holding another red oval-backed wooden chair by its back opening, chair tilted with legs down-right. Preserve all exact contacts and the top-heavy asymmetric composition; do not turn it into ordinary seated dining.

SMDATE4 003: Johnny is almost entirely hidden beneath a table he carries high, the billowing white tablecloth covers his head and hat. Only his blue waistcoat/red bowtie at center, two bent black-clad legs and bare feet appear below. One hand grips the elevated chair/table structure at lower left under the cloth; the other holds a red oval-back wooden chair projecting down-right. Above the cloth are two small white plates with green food on the left and yellow food on the right. Preserve this deliberate hidden-face pose, floating food and red chairs below rather than showing his head through the table.

Two clear stemmed wine glasses only, tilted inward to touch rims in a toast. The left glass tilts clockwise toward center; the right glass tilts counterclockwise toward center. Exactly two white plates hover over table, green food above left plate and yellow above right; two red-wine glasses above them. Preserve cloth curls and overlapping furniture.

Johnny is at left behind a red oval-backed wooden chair and a tilted white-clothed dining table. His top hat and face peek behind the left upper edge of cloth looking right, largely occluded torso. His two black-clad legs and bare feet show below, left foot lifted and right foot planted. Above table float two angled white plates with green food left and yellow food right, and two red-wine glasses above. Preserve chaotic balanced furniture and source limb hiding.

Preserve the source left-facing body and clearly connected backward chair grip.

Mermaid alone shoots diagonally up-right out of water, body long, straight green tail points down-left partly cut at original bottom, head turns right three-quarter showing two eyes and playful open mouth. Near arm on right hangs straight down-right and far arm on left trails back down-left. Long yellow hair streams to left, cyan headband stays. Preserve slender midriff, green swimsuit top and green fish-tail starting at waist, white small motion/water streaks beside lower tail. No Johnny in this frame.

One sprite containing two characters separated by a small gap: adult mermaid flies up-right on left with green fish-tail extending down-left, long yellow hair billowing, cyan band, green swimsuit top, face right, arms trailing down-left and down-right; tuxedo Johnny stands on right leaning slightly backward to catch her, looking up-left, elbows bent and hands reaching forward at waist/chest height, both bare feet below. Preserve exact size relationship, her head higher than his hat and both characters whole together. Sparse white water droplets trail her tail. Do not make them touch yet.

One paired sprite: Johnny on right catches adult mermaid against his chest. Her long green tail sweeps left and downward, forked fin at far lower-left, her upper body and yellow hair above his shoulder. We see mainly the back of her head with cyan band; hair hides her eyes. Her near arm extends outward to right with open hand; her other arm folds around Johnny at his shoulder. His far/supporting arm wraps around her upper back and near/supporting arm cups beneath her waist, with continuous shoulder-elbow-hand connections, no extra arms. His hat and most face are hidden behind her hair/torso; bent knees and two bare feet remain visible, staggered under them. White water arcs follow tail.

Her green tail projects horizontally left then arches into broad forked fin at far left. Her bare back/arms show above green waist; she clings around Johnny's shoulders, his torso and face mostly hidden behind her. Johnny squats on right with deeply bent black-trousered knees and two staggered bare feet. His supporting hands stay in physical contact around her waist and upper back, no disconnected/extra arms. Preserve this rear view and white looping water-motion arc behind tail.
